text:
support_jen: Hey team, escalation from AcmeCorp. Customers see partial SSE events, then client reconnects and gets duplicate partial chunks. They also reported unexpected billing spikes when clients reconnect repeatedly. Repro steps below. :warning:

support_jen: Repro (simplified):
1) Client connects to our hosted endpoint via an intermediate gRPC->HTTP1 gateway.
2) Server streams SSE events over HTTP/2 origin, gateway translates to HTTP/1.1 chunked to client.
3) Around 7-12s into stream, gateway cuts connection (no 200->EOF), client reconnects, sometimes receives tail of previous event plus start of next event as one chunk.

support_jen: Curl repro we used:```
curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \  
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \  
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-mini"
```

jason_sre: Logs look like proxy inserted content-length or buffered chunks. Gateway is nginx-based; we see `proxy_buffering on` in config. Also saw truncated chunk boundaries in logs: `recv() returned 0` then immediate upstream reconnect. :mag:

tim_infra: Can you paste the raw TCP capture or chunked frames? If gateway is translating h2->h1 it may coalesce multiple SSE payloads into a single HTTP/1.1 chunk if Transfer-Encoding is used. That would break SSE event boundaries if the client expects per-line events.

support_jen: Attached snippet from the gateway log:```
[2026-01-30T15:12:05Z] upstream closed prematurely: client: 10.1.2.3, server: api.redwood.ai, request: "/v1/stream?model=gpt-mini"
[2026-01-30T15:12:05Z] proxy_buffering: on, buffered 8KiB
```

alex_ml: Also noticed auth rotation: the token used was near expiry at T+600s, but the disconnects happen earlier. Wondering if gateway retries on 401 mid-stream and causes replays. Any evidence of 401s?

support_jen: No 401s in the trace. However customers reported one reconnect sequence where reconnect auth failed (401) and client retried a second time successfully; billing showed 2 partial sessions billed.

maya_prod: From product side, customers expect dedup on reconnect (idempotent SSE). We currently bill per session(tokenized output). We should confirm policy for partial streams — flag for billing group.

tim_infra: Immediate mitigations: disable proxy_buffering for the SSE route, ensure `proxy_request_buffering off` and `chunked_transfer_encoding off` at the gateway so it streams as passthrough. Also set `Connection: keep-alive` sticky behavior.

jason_sre: Proposed config snippet for nginx ingress:```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_request_buffering off;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  chunked_transfer_encoding off;
  proxy_set_header Connection ""; # let client handle keepalive
}
```

devops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1347 -> assigned to @tim_infra + @jason_sre. Severity: P2. :ticket:

alex_ml: For longer term, runtime should emit SSE event boundaries aligned with HTTP/1 chunk boundaries or include explicit event IDs so clients can dedupe on reconnect. We can also add a `X-Stream-Event-Id` header per event for easier dedup.

support_jen: Customer asked for repro steps we can share. I sent them the curl above plus a small node client that reconnects on close and logs partial events. Also asked if they can point a tcpdump at the gateway.

jason_sre: Next steps: 1) Roll nginx ingress config change to disable buffering on canary domain, 2) ask customer to reproduce, capture tcpdump, 3) billing to evaluate credit for duplicate partial sessions, 4) infra to audit auth rotation interactions.

support_jen: Marking as in-progress. Will follow up with customer and paste tcpdump/pcap when available. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
